findings.rule: Dependency rule / type-only import leak: shared domain contract imports an infrastructure row type (SKILL rules 1 & 9)
findings.explanation: The client-mirrored domain contract imports the Drizzle row type ReportRunRow from modules/reports/repository.ts and embeds it in ReportDetailDto.latestRun. This is a domain-to-infrastructure dependency (import type counts), it couples the hand-synced vendor/shared surface to server DB internals (the '../../modules/...' path does not exist in the client mirror), and it lets a raw Drizzle row — including internal fields like workspaceId — flow to HTTP unmapped instead of being converted at the boundary. ReportDetailDto is consequently a hand-written interface rather than a Zod-derived shape.
findings.fix: Define latestRun as a Zod schema in the contract (only the wire fields, e.g. reportDetailSchema extending reportSummarySchema) and derive ReportDetailDto via z.infer; map ReportRunRow to that shape in modules/reports/helpers.ts (toReportDetailDto) so no server type is named in vendor/shared and no raw row reaches HTTP.
